out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: No paper towels were observed at the hand sink next to the veggie wash prep sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REFILLED THE PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER.

violations.title: Cooking Raw Animal Foods, Minimum of 145F
violations.observation: Oven roasted salmon was observed at 95F. According to the menu serving oven roasted salmon, the salmon dish was observed without a consumer advisory.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods such as eggs, fish, pork, and commercially raised game animals shall be cooked to heat all parts of the food to a minimum internal temperature of 145F for at least 15 seconds. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO PUT THE SALMON BACK IN THE OVEN TO COOK TO A MINIMUM OF 145F. SALMON WAS LATER OBSERVED AT 163F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 3DR lowboy B cooler: marinara sauce (43f), Alfredo sauce (45f); 2) in the 2DR lowboy B cooler: green curry (51f); 3) in the 3DR prep top Lime Salt: shredded lettuce (44f); 4) in the 3DR prep top A2 Cold: pico de gallo (43f), blue cheese dressing (45f), shredded cabbage (46f); 5) in the 3DR prep top A1 Cold: sliced tomato (44f), cut lettuce (44f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: Observed no high temperature dish plate or irreversible registering temperature stickers on site
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PIC ORDER A HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH PLATE.

violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink, located in the back by the 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will replace the paper towels at the hand sink for compliance.

violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: pizza sauce in pot (117F)
violations.corrective_action: The EHS educated the CFM on the proper hot holding temperature for the sauce and the CFM discarded the sauce for compliance.
